purpose: Validate that governance snapshot comparisons correctly detect technical state transitions without rewriting history or misrepresenting legal or publication status.

checks.name: Input integrity
checks.requirement: Comparison requires identifiable before and after snapshots with capture dates.

checks.name: Transition coverage
checks.requirement: Contract can represent unchanged, improved, regressed, blocker and revalidation/closure transitions.

checks.name: Historical integrity
checks.requirement: Comparison cannot modify or currentize the earlier snapshot.

checks.name: Legal separation
checks.requirement: Technical state changes cannot be treated as legal-source changes without separate evidence.

checks.name: Evidence separation
checks.requirement: Production evidence changes require actual evidence records.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Publication status remains governed by its independent gate.

checks.name: Conflict handling
checks.requirement: Identity or capture-date conflicts block comparison.

guardrails: It does not verify Irish property law.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
